items.title: 6.6.2.2 Integration with Other Emerging Technologies (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain ko AI aur IoT jaisi doosri emerging technologies ke saath joda ja raha hai, jis se naye mauqe aur synergies (mil kar zyada faida) paida ho rahe hain. Yeh mel dono technologies ki capabilities (kya kya kar sakti hai) barhata aur innovations (nayi cheezein aur naye tareeqe) ke raste kholta hai.

AI aur blockchain ko milane se data ki security aur transparency (sab kuch sab ko saaf nazar aana) barh sakti hai. AI algorithms blockchain par rakhe data ka analysis (jaanch parakh) kar sakte hain; blockchain data ki integrity (data ka sahi aur poora rehna) yaqeeni banata hai, aur privacy ko nuqsan pohanchaye baghair valuable insights (kaam ki nayi baatein) milte hain.

Misal (Example): supply chain management mein AI blockchain par rakhe mehfooz aur transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) data ke sahare demand ka andaza lagata aur logistics (maal ko le jana aur pohanchana) behtar banata hai, jis se supply chain efficient aur reliable banti hai.

IoT ko blockchain se jorne se IoT devices ke darmiyan data ka len den mehfooz aur transparent hota hai. Blockchain ki decentralized structure IoT data record karne ke liye tamper-proof (chhed chhaar se mehfooz) ledger deti hai, jis se bharosa aur hifazat barhti hai.

Misal (Example): agriculture (kheti bari) mein IoT sensors mitti ki halat aur fasal ki sehat dekhte hain aur data blockchain par record hota hai. Is se data ke asli hone ka yaqeen hota hai, aur kisan soch samajh kar faisle karte aur crop yields (fasal ki paidawar) barhate hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Sochiye ke blockchain ko AI ya IoT se jorna aap ki community (ilaqe) ko kya faida de sakta hai. Classmates se baat karein aur aisa project suggest karein jo in technologies se kisi local masle ko hal kare.

Khulasa (In conclusion): cloud computing aur blockchain ke future trends technology mein bari tarraqi la rahe hain. Edge computing aur serverless architectures cloud computing ki performance aur scalability barha rahe hain, jabke Blockchain 2.0 aur blockchain ka doosri technologies se mel us ke istemal aur capabilities ko phaila raha hai. Yeh trends bohat si industries ko badal denge aur innovations aur tarraqi ke mauqe denge.

blocks.prompt: AI ko blockchain ke saath jorna data management ko kaise faida deta hai (exercise MCQ 12)? Blockchain ko AI aur IoT se jorna naye mauqe aur synergies kaise banata hai (long question 7)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 12: (b) data security aur transparency barhati hai. IoT devices data jama karte hain, blockchain use tamper-proof aur sab ke liye reliable record banata hai, aur AI us data ka analysis kar ke andaze aur faisle deta hai. Maslan supply chain mein AI blockchain ke data se demand ka andaza lagata hai, aur khet mein IoT sensors ka data blockchain par record ho kar kisanon ko behtar faisle mein madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: blockchain ko AI ya IoT se jorne wala local project.
blocks.explanation: Maslan gaon mein doodh ki khareedari: IoT sensors har kisan ke doodh ki miqdar aur quality naapte hain, readings blockchain par record hoti hain taake payment fair ho aur record badla na ja sake, aur AI dairy ke liye aane wali supply ka andaza lagata hai. Pesh karte waqt masla, data, technology aur faida uthane wale bataiye. (Yeh sirf namuna hai, kitab mein nahi.)

items: AI + blockchain: mehfooz, transparent data ka analysis (supply chain ki misal).
IoT + blockchain: tamper-proof IoT data (kheti ki misal).
Edge, serverless aur Blockchain 2.0 industries badal rahe hain.
